escalations.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read / RCE via tinypool prototype pollution
escalations.exploit_scenario: When Vitest UI server is listening on network, any reachable host can read arbitrary files and trigger code execution via tinypool prototype pollution. CI environments exposing Vitest UI externally are compromised.
escalations.impact: Full test infrastructure compromise → production code execution. Secrets in CI environment may be exfiltrated.

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker supplies a crafted Handlebars template via AST Type Confusion. If any user input flows into Handlebars template compilation, full RCE is achievable.
escalations.impact: Server-side template injection → arbitrary code execution on backend hosts.
escalations.fix: npm audit fix in each affected project (updates handlebars to >=4.7.10)

escalations.title: Proxy-addr IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing via Express
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends requests with crafted IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses that bypass trust subnet checks. IP-based access control, allowlists, rate limiting, and audit logs can be spoofed to appear as trusted internal addresses.
escalations.impact: Bypass of network-layer access controls on all Express-based services.
escalations.fix: npm audit fix in each project (updates express → proxy-addr >=2.0.8)

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via gRPC in platform/orchestrator
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends a crafted protobuf message to the gRPC-exposed orchestrator. Prototype pollution gadgets trigger arbitrary code execution. Also exploitable for DoS via recursive message payloads.
escalations.impact: Full RCE on the orchestrator host. Attacker could hijack or corrupt all pipeline execution.

p1_findings.title: Canonical spec describes a completely different product — 0 of 69 FRs covered
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any engineer using the canonical spec to design features, write tests, or audit compliance will produce work for a system that does not exist. All 69 FR traceability IDs are dead references.
p1_findings.impact: All spec-driven quality gates are meaningless. Teams that read the spec before coding will implement wrong features. Audits citing spec compliance are invalid.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Specifications/work-item-workflow.md describing the actual Work Item system. Extend tools/traceability-enforcer.py to scan Specifications/ alongside Plans/.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer is a false compliance gate — never scans Specifications/
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan Specifications/ directory and validate FR-XXX IDs against canonical specs.

p2_findings.title: Source references FR-WF-001..013 / FR-dependency-* IDs that exist only in plan files, not canonical Specifications/
